title: A股休市、港股迎并购复牌与消费韧性；油价与长债高位约束科技估值
summary: A股国庆休市至10月7日；港股今日开市。10月2日旧时段AKShare显示港股405涨、1328跌、1073平，恒指/恒科约跌2.63%/2.53%。隔夜美股军工、铜、通信与太空领涨，运行时期指温和上行但代表股夜盘报价不可得；油价和长债高位限制估值。致丰工业电子列条件关注，百威亚太与中华银科技列回避。

关键词云图

A股休市油价再升并购复牌军工领涨铜链走强通信设备太空+5.16%百威拨备停牌风险算力传闻新型电池期指微升
利好利空中性
重大新闻汇总
国际
胡塞武装声称袭击沙特能源设施，油价重新上行
Reuters 10月5日06:02 CST快照显示布伦特涨0.79%至103.06美元、WTI涨0.50%至91.57美元；供应风险利好港股油气上游，但继续压制航空、物流、化工下游及长久期科技估值。
政策
七部门发布新型电池“十五五”规划
工信系统原始政策信息显示，到2030年全固态电池初步规模化应用、长寿命锂电循环寿命达到1.5万次，并拓展储能、智能终端、机器人等场景；受益必须以订单与价格确认，不能把规划目标当作已实现业绩。
政策
福建以法定决定推动科技创新与产业创新融合
福建省政府10月1日发布省人大常委会决定，提出聚焦新能源、新材料、基础软件、工业软件和人工智能，并推动研发投入强度到2030年提高至2.7%以上；区域平台、成果转化和先进制造获得中期政策线索。
产业
腾讯据报拟向Oracle租用约10万枚先进芯片
Reuters转述《金融时报》称潜在五年合同约70亿美元、约30%预付；Reuters未能独立核实，腾讯与Oracle未置评。算力供给是正向线索，但高额资本承诺与消息未确认构成反证，腾讯不据此升级为多头卡。
美股
军工、铜、通信与太空领涨，IT服务和广告居后
10月2日Moomoo快照显示航空航天与国防+3.90%、铜+3.73%、通信设备+3.33%，太空概念+5.16%；IT服务-2.72%、广告代理-3.30%。ELMT、TGB、SILC和PL分别涨8.75%、7.70%、11.93%和8.43%，A/H映射须等港股开盘与A股10月8日复市验证。
产业
中国暂停10月对港澳以外成品油出口，亚洲炼油利润率走高
Reuters称10月成品油出口配额执行暂停，亚洲汽油裂解价差升至每桶50美元以上纪录区间；炼化供给偏紧利好区域炼油利润，但高油价也加重运输和制造成本。
公司
致丰工业电子获立讯精密子公司提出收购75%股权意向
港交所10月2日公告显示双方签订非约束性备忘录并给予两个月独家期；若落实或触发强制全面要约，股份拟于10月5日09:00复牌。尚无正式协议、作价或成交后价格确认，交易亦可能不进行。
公司
百威亚太披露税项费用与应收账款拨备
港交所10月4日公告称内部重组将产生约5200万美元非基础性预提税费用，并就印度特伦甘纳政府饮料公司逾期应收款在三季度计提约3000万美元；10月2日股价收5.68港元、跌3.97%，负面价格反馈先于公告。
公司
中华银科技延迟业绩并继续停牌
港交所10月2日公告显示2025/26中期及全年业绩继续延迟，股份自2025年10月2日起停牌且仍待满足复牌指引；现金短缺、审核不确定性和不可交易状态构成明确回避理由。
宏观
香港8月零售销售延续复苏，但汽车品类下滑
香港政府数据经Reuters核验显示，8月零售额同比增5.6%至321亿港元、连续第16个月增长，首八个月增8.5%；珠宝钟表增11.9%，汽车及零部件跌22%，消费复苏仍明显分化。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
三大期指温和上行，长债和油价仍高
Investors.com于08:05 CST发布的延迟快照显示道指期货+0.10%、标普500期货+0.10%、纳指100期货+0.25%，10年期美债收益率约5.26%；Reuters 06:02 CST显示WTI涨0.50%至91.57美元。报价不在生成前30分钟内，明确只作方向参考。
板块对照
指数偏强构成宏观层面的部分确认，代表股逐项未确认
ELMT、TGB、SILC、FLUX、SSM、QTEX、GRNQ、CYCU、CIRC、SWAG、PL、EVGO、DDD、TSLA、OUST的同一时点可靠夜盘报价均不可得；因此不能把周五涨跌默认延续。期指微升对军工、通信、太空仅属部分确认，高油价与5.26%长债构成背离，尚无可核验反转信号。
A/H映射
A股休市，港股先看并购复牌和能源相对强度
军工、铜、通信、充电桩与激光雷达的美股强势提供方向线索，但A股要到10月8日才有价格验证；港股今日关注01710复牌、油气上游相对表现及恒科能否摆脱10月2日弱势。若油价继续上冲且恒科跑输恒指，科技映射失效。

盘前结论

A股国庆休市至10月7日；港股今日开市，南向互联互通仍受内地假期安排影响。AKShare最新文件仅覆盖9月30日A股与10月2日13:26左右港股盘中：A股2566涨、2824跌、中位数-0.09%；港股405涨、1328跌、1073平，恒指和恒科约跌2.63%与2.53%，这些均不是今日盘中数据。

美股军工、铜、通信和太空领涨，致丰工业电子复牌并购意向提供公司级催化。但油价回到103美元附近、10年期美债约5.26%，百威拨备与中华银停牌风险压制风险偏好。

基准判断为港股分化而非全面追涨：油气上游和事件驱动可能相对抗跌，恒科修复需成交与相对强度确认；A股相关映射只列10月8日复市观察，不把休市期新闻当作已被价格验证。

重点个股关注

致丰工业电子
HK.01710
条件关注
立讯精密旗下买方拟收购75%股权，备忘录非约束、独家期两个月；停牌前最后有成交收盘为9月29日2.06港元，10月5日09:00拟复牌，尚无公告后价格反馈。
确认条件：正式协议披露作价与资金安排，复牌后成交活跃且价格守住停牌前收盘，并相对港股电子制造板块取得正超额。
风险与失效：交易可能不进行，强制要约条款、审批、融资或复牌后冲高回落均使关注失效；不把意向书当作已完成收购。
百威亚太
HK.01876
回避
10月4日公告新增约5200万美元非基础性税项费用及约3000万美元应收款拨备；10月2日收5.68港元、跌3.97%，披露前价格已偏弱。
解除条件：开盘后重新站上5.68港元并放量强于必需消费板块，同时公司说明回款进度与一次性费用边界。
风险与失效：政府客户回款、盈利质量与消费复苏持续性仍有不确定性；若继续放量下跌，维持回避。
中华银科技
HK.00515
回避
中期及全年业绩继续延迟，股份自2025年10月2日起停牌，当前没有可交易报价；公司披露现金短缺并继续推进融资与审核。
解除条件：刊发完整经审计财务资料、满足复牌指引并恢复有序交易。
风险与失效：审计、持续经营、融资与流动性风险均未解决，任何未经核验的复牌或融资传闻不构成转多依据。

板块轮动看板

油气/炼化上游油价与炼化利润率提供支撑，但地缘溢价同时提高宏观与下游成本风险。
港股电子并购致丰工业电子具备可核验意向事件，升级必须等待正式条款与复牌价格。
军工/铜/通信/太空隔夜美股广度偏强，但A股休市、港股缺少同主题公司级价格确认，暂作方向观察。
IT服务/广告/长久期科技隔夜行业垫底且长债收益率约5.26%，高估值修复仍受压。

逻辑链

胡塞袭击声明 → Brent重回103美元上方 → 能源上游相对受益、下游成本和通胀风险上升。
美股军工、铜、通信与太空领涨 → A/H主题方向改善 → 港股开盘与A股10月8日复市才是本地验证。
期指仅温和上涨且10年债约5.26% → 宏观信号与科技板块强势部分背离 → 不把周五涨幅外推为今日确认。
公司级公告优先 → 01710等待复牌条款和价格，01876与00515按明确负面证据回避。

风险雷达

油价与地缘升级能源设施进一步受袭或Brent继续上冲，将加重通胀、运输成本与成长估值压力。
复牌与小盘流动性01710的非约束意向可能不落地，复牌后跳空和回撤风险均高。
快照时效AKShare文件为9月30日/10月2日旧时段；15只排行代表股运行时夜盘报价不可得，均已降级而未外推。

数据来源与时间点

数据来源与截止：福建省政府（10月1日科技与产业创新决定）、工信系统（9月28日新型电池规划）、港交所公告（01710、01876、00515，10月2日至4日）、Reuters（中东与油价、腾讯芯片租赁报道、中国成品油出口、香港零售、10月5日08:44 CST前核验）、财联社/科创板日报早报页（金十与交叉源在假期窗口未检出10月5日新增可核验头条）。AKShare GitHub Actions文件抓取于10月2日13:38 CST，仅作旧时段基线。美股排行抓取于10月3日09:25 CST并覆盖10月2日现金时段。Investors.com期指快照发布时间08:05 CST；代表股夜盘批量检索于08:43 CST均无可靠同一时点报价。生成时间：2026-10-05 08:49 CST。

Keyword Cloud

A shares closedOil rises againDeal reopeningDefense leadsCopper strengthCommunicationsSpace +5.16%Bud provisionsSuspension riskCompute reportAdvanced batteryFutures edge up
PositiveNegativeNeutral
Major News
Global
Houthi claims against Saudi energy sites lift oil again
A Reuters snapshot at 06:02 CST on Oct 5 showed Brent up 0.79% at $103.06 and WTI up 0.50% at $91.57. Supply risk supports Hong Kong upstream oil names but pressures airlines, logistics, chemical users and long-duration technology valuations.
Policy
Seven agencies release the 15th Five-Year Plan for advanced batteries
Primary industry-policy material targets initial mass adoption of all-solid-state batteries and 15,000-cycle long-life lithium batteries by 2030, with storage, smart devices and robotics among the use cases. Targets are not current earnings and require order and price confirmation.
Policy
Fujian formalizes deeper integration of technology and industrial innovation
The Fujian government published a provincial legislature decision on Oct 1 covering renewables, new materials, basic and industrial software, and AI, while targeting R&D intensity above 2.7% by 2030. It offers a medium-term policy signal for platforms, commercialization and advanced manufacturing.
Industry
Tencent reportedly considers leasing roughly 100,000 advanced chips from Oracle
Reuters cited the Financial Times on a possible five-year, roughly $7 billion contract with about 30% prepaid. Reuters could not independently verify it and neither company commented. Compute access is positive, but the unconfirmed report and large capital commitment prevent a bullish upgrade.
US moves
Defense, copper, communications and space lead; IT services and advertising lag
The Oct 2 Moomoo snapshot showed Aerospace & Defense +3.90%, Copper +3.73%, Communication Equipment +3.33% and Space +5.16%, while IT Services fell 2.72% and Advertising Agencies 3.30%. ELMT, TGB, SILC and PL rose 8.75%, 7.70%, 11.93% and 8.43%; A/H mapping still needs Hong Kong open and the Oct 8 A-share reopening.
Industry
China suspends October fuel-product exports beyond Hong Kong and Macao
Reuters reported that October export-quota execution was paused and Asian gasoline refining margins moved above $50 a barrel into record territory. Tighter regional supply can help refiners, but expensive fuel raises transport and manufacturing costs.
Company
Trio Industrial Electronics receives an approach from a Luxshare unit for 75%
An Oct 2 HKEX filing says the parties signed a non-binding MOU with two months of exclusivity. Completion could trigger a mandatory general offer and trading is set to resume at 09:00 on Oct 5. There is no definitive agreement, price or post-announcement market confirmation, and the deal may not proceed.
Company
Budweiser APAC flags tax expense and a receivables provision
Its Oct 4 HKEX filing says an internal restructuring will create about $52 million of non-underlying withholding-tax expense, while about $30 million will be provided in Q3 against overdue receivables from a Telangana government beverage company. The stock closed at HK$5.68, down 3.97%, on Oct 2 before the filing.
Company
China Silver Technology delays results and remains suspended
Its Oct 2 HKEX filing says FY2025/26 interim and annual results remain delayed. The shares have been suspended since Oct 2, 2025 and still need to satisfy resumption guidance. Cash strain, audit uncertainty and illiquidity support an Avoid status.
Macro
Hong Kong August retail sales extend recovery, while autos contract
Hong Kong government data verified by Reuters showed August retail sales up 5.6% year on year to HK$32.1 billion, the 16th straight increase, and the first eight months up 8.5%. Jewellery and watches rose 11.9%, while motor vehicles and parts fell 22%, underscoring an uneven recovery.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Futures
All three futures gauges edge higher while yields and oil stay elevated
A delayed Investors.com snapshot published at 08:05 CST showed Dow futures +0.10%, S&P 500 futures +0.10% and Nasdaq-100 futures +0.25%, with the 10-year Treasury yield near 5.26%. Reuters at 06:02 CST showed WTI +0.50% at $91.57. These quotes are older than 30 minutes at generation and are directional only.
Cross-check
Index strength provides partial confirmation, but every representative stock remains unconfirmed
Reliable same-time overnight quotes were unavailable for ELMT, TGB, SILC, FLUX, SSM, QTEX, GRNQ, CYCU, CIRC, SWAG, PL, EVGO, DDD, TSLA and OUST, so Friday moves are not assumed to persist. Firmer futures partially confirm defense, communications and space at the macro level, while expensive oil and a 5.26% yield create divergence; there is no verified reversal signal.
A/H mapping
A shares are closed; Hong Kong first tests the deal reopening and energy relative strength
U.S. strength in defense, copper, communications, EV charging and lidar offers directional clues, but A shares cannot confirm until Oct 8. Hong Kong should test HK.01710 on resumption, upstream oil relative performance and whether Hang Seng Tech can reverse Oct 2 weakness. A further oil spike with technology underperforming the Hang Seng invalidates the growth mapping.

Pre-open View

Mainland A shares are closed through Oct 7; Hong Kong opens today, while southbound Stock Connect remains constrained by the mainland holiday timetable.The latest AKShare file covers only Sep 30 A shares and around 13:26 on Oct 2 in Hong Kong: 2,566 A-share advancers, 2,824 decliners and a -0.09% median; 405 Hong Kong advancers, 1,328 decliners and 1,073 unchanged, with the Hang Seng and Hang Seng Tech down about 2.63% and 2.53%. None are current intraday data.

U.S. defense, copper, communications and space led, while Trio offers a company-specific reopening catalyst.But oil near $103 Brent, a roughly 5.26% 10-year yield, Budweiser provisions and China Silver’s suspension constrain risk appetite.

The base case is Hong Kong dispersion, not a broad chase: upstream energy and event-driven names may outperform, while a Hang Seng Tech rebound needs volume and relative-strength confirmation. A-share mappings are Oct 8 reopening watches and are not presented as price-confirmed during the closure.

Stocks to Watch

Trio Industrial Electronics
HK.01710
Conditional Watch
A Luxshare-controlled buyer proposes acquiring 75% under a non-binding MOU with two months of exclusivity. The last traded close before suspension was HK$2.06 on Sep 29; trading is due to resume at 09:00 on Oct 5, so no post-announcement price confirmation exists.
Confirmation: a definitive agreement discloses price and funding, and active resumed trading holds above the pre-suspension close with positive excess return versus Hong Kong electronics manufacturers.
Risk/invalidation: the deal may not proceed; mandatory-offer terms, approvals, financing or a failed reopening rally invalidate the watch. The MOU is not treated as a completed acquisition.
Budweiser APAC
HK.01876
Avoid
The Oct 4 filing adds roughly $52 million of non-underlying tax expense and a roughly $30 million receivables provision. The shares already closed 3.97% lower at HK$5.68 on Oct 2 before the filing.
Removal condition: it reclaims HK$5.68 on volume, outperforms consumer staples, and management clarifies collections and the one-off scope.
Risk/invalidation: government-customer collections, earnings quality and the durability of consumption recovery remain uncertain; further volume-led weakness keeps the Avoid status.
China Silver Technology
HK.00515
Avoid
Interim and annual results remain delayed and the shares have been suspended since Oct 2, 2025, leaving no tradable quote. The company reports cash strain while pursuing financing and audit work.
Removal condition: complete audited financials are published, resumption guidance is satisfied, and orderly trading resumes.
Risk/invalidation: audit, going-concern, financing and liquidity risks remain unresolved; unverified resumption or funding rumours do not justify an upgrade.

Sector Rotation Board

Upstream oil/refiningOil and refining margins support relative strength, but the geopolitical premium also raises macro and downstream cost risk.
Hong Kong electronics dealTrio has a verified approach, but an upgrade requires definitive terms and the resumption price.
Defense/copper/comms/spaceU.S. breadth was firm, but A shares are closed and Hong Kong lacks same-theme company-level price confirmation.
IT services/advertising/long durationThese U.S. industries lagged and a roughly 5.26% yield continues to restrain expensive growth.

Logic Chain

Houthi attack claims → Brent above $103 → relative support for upstream energy, but more inflation and downstream cost risk.
U.S. defense, copper, communications and space lead → better A/H thematic direction → Hong Kong open and the Oct 8 A-share reopening provide local confirmation.
Futures only modestly higher and the 10-year near 5.26% → partial divergence from strong technology themes → no extrapolation of Friday’s gains.
Company filings take priority → HK.01710 awaits terms and resumption price; HK.01876 and HK.00515 remain Avoid on verified negatives.

Risk Radar

Oil and geopolitical escalationFurther attacks or another Brent surge would add inflation, transport-cost and growth-valuation pressure.
Resumption and small-cap liquidityHK.01710’s non-binding approach may not complete, and both a gap and a failed reopening rally are material risks.
Snapshot freshnessThe AKShare file is from Sep 30/Oct 2; runtime overnight quotes for all 15 ranking representatives were unavailable and were not extrapolated.

Sources and Timestamps

Sources and cutoff: Fujian government (Oct 1 technology-industry decision), industry ministry material (Sep 28 advanced-battery plan), HKEX filings (HK.01710, HK.01876 and HK.00515, Oct 2-4), and Reuters (Middle East/oil, the Tencent chip-lease report, Chinese fuel exports and Hong Kong retail, verified through 08:44 CST on Oct 5). The CLS/STAR Market Daily page was checked; Jin10 and the cross-source search produced no new verifiable Oct 5 holiday-window headline. The AKShare GitHub Actions file was fetched at 13:38 CST on Oct 2 and is prior-session evidence only. The U.S. ranking file was fetched at 09:25 CST on Oct 3 for the Oct 2 cash session. Investors.com published the futures snapshot at 08:05 CST; the representative-stock batch check at 08:43 CST found no reliable same-time overnight quotes. Generated: 2026-10-05 08:49 CST.
